note: Alt text for every image file on the MyHealthOpinions patient site. In the running site, chapter-illustration alt text is translated (translated chapter title + “illustration” / “completion badge”); flag alt text uses the English language name. The 3D orb, helix, vital cards, particles, emoji, the Health Rewards Card face and the ink stamps on the reward board (drawn in CSS/SVG, not image files) are decorative and marked aria-hidden; the card, stamp buttons, points counter and tiers carry translated labels instead. "longAlt" is a fuller description for documentation or CMS use.
